data.cultural_impact: The name Constance carries a sense of reliability, constancy, and steadfastness. Historically, it has been attributed to strong, unyielding women, such as St. Constance, who endured persecution and hardships for their faith. Today, this name continues to inspire strength and resilience in individuals who face challenges in their personal and professional lives.
data.spiritual_significance: Constance is a name that resonates with the spiritual qualities of faithfulness, endurance, and unwavering commitment. The saint Constance, for instance, demonstrated her deep conviction through her unwavering witness, even in the face of adversity. For believers, the name Constance serves as a reminder of the importance of keeping faith during difficult times and to remain steadfast in our beliefs and values.

historical_references.reference: Constance of Arles, also known as Constance of Provence, was a Christian saint and the daughter of King Provençal of Arles. She is best known for her role in the Miracle of the Veil, where her veil was said to have wept tears of blood when she was falsely accused of adultery. This event occurred during the reign of Emperor Constantine the Great (306-337 AD).

Constance of Bohemia, also known as Constance of Sicily, was the last Queen Consort of the Kingdom of Hungary. She married King Ladislaus V Jagellon in 1471, but her husband died in battle in 1457. Subsequently, she married King Casimir IV of Poland in 1457, and after his death in 1492, she married King John Albert I of Poland. Her final marriage was to King Louis II of Hungary in 1515, and she died in 1520. Her most notable act as queen was her role in the Council of Basel, where she advocated for peace between the papacy and the Holy Roman Empire, leading to the compromise of the Compact of Basel in 1433.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Constance holds a rich history dating back to the late Roman Empire, but in modern times, it is often associated with royalty, historical fiction, and femininity. In literature, Constance is a popular name for characters in historical novels and fairy tales, evoking images of strong, regal women. On TV shows such as 'Reign' and 'The Tudors', Constance is portrayed as a powerful and influential figure in the court of medieval monarchs. In fashion, Constance is a popular name for clothing brands and accessories, symbolizing timeless, elegant style.
